newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: ANGLOVAAL CAUTIONS FURTHER ON RESTRUCTURING.
newsitem.headline: ANGLOVAAL CAUTIONS FURTHER ON RESTRUCTURING.

text.p: Anglovaal Ltd said that, with regard to the proposed reorganisation of its mining and mineral interests, shareholders were advised to continue to exercise caution in dealing in its shares and securities.
Anglovaal cautioned share and security holders that while significant progress had been made, the reorganisation process was complex, subject to approvals and not yet finalised.
Anglovaal said a further announcement, which would include the terms of the proposed reorganisation, was expected to made later this month.
Share and security holders in Anglovaal Holdings , Middle Witwatersrand (Western Areas) Ltd and Target were also urged to exercise caution.
Earlier cautionary announcements were published on May 17, August 27 and September 12.
